basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore has released the official Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Notification 2026 at https://www.iiti.ac.in/. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026. Candidates up to 28 years of age with M.Tech./M.E./M.S., B.Tech./B.E., or M.Sc. in the relevant disciplines along with the prescribed GATE/UGC-CSIR JRF/ equivalent qualifications are eligible to apply through email on or before 14 August 2026. The official notification PDF and application details are available on the official website.

qualification.education_qualification: M.Tech./ M.E./ M.S., B.Tech./ B.E. OR M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, Nanoscience and Technology
qualification.details: M.Tech./ M.E./ M.S. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering. Candidates having MTech/ME/MS degrees should have previously qualified GATE once. B.Tech./ B.E. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering/Engineering Physics. Candidates having B.Tech./B.E. degree should have a valid GATE score. M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, Nanoscience and Technology. Candidates having M.Sc. Degree should have a valid GATE qualification OR UGC/CSIR-JRF qualification OR Equivalent Fellowship.

selection_process: Shortlisting based on merit and project requirements Online Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Indore is 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include M.Tech./M.E./M.S. or B.Tech./B.E. in relevant engineering fields with GATE, or M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, or Nanoscience with GATE/UGC/CSIR-JRF.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Indore JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their applications via email to the specified address, ensuring all required documents are attached.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this IIT Indore recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment for the Junior Research Fellow position.
